answer: Trading capacity expires each epoch. haven binds every key of one operator to a single lagoon, which records its active-key count \(k\); tide restores trading for that whole lagoon only when \(10k^2\) USDC is burned. Ten clones therefore burn 1,000 USDC per epoch, versus 10 for an honest debut, and the tenth adds 190 USDC to each epoch’s bill. Underpayment idles every key, so clones cannot renew separately or divide the bill.
